https://dev.roost.ai.core_purpose: Provide automated environments for software testing and development, enabling faster and more efficient workflows for DevOps teams.
business_requirements: Users must be able to create and manage virtual environments for software testing with minimal manual configuration.
Users must be able to integrate the platform with popular CI/CD tools for seamless deployment workflows.
Users must be able to monitor the status and performance of active environments via a dashboard interface.
Users must be able to schedule or trigger automated environment creation based on predefined rules or events.
Users must be able to clone or replicate existing environments to test multiple use cases simultaneously.
Users must have access to usage analytics and reporting features to assess environment utilization and efficiency.
Users must be able to securely manage access permissions for team members and external collaborators.
